mission: Verify K2-HEAL-01 + K2-HEAL-02 LIVE race protection on POST /api/admin/pos/counter-collect/{order}/confirm
approach: HTTP race via concurrent curl with distinct Sanctum tokens per cashier + distinct X-Idempotency-Key per request (Playwright multi-tab cannot fire simultaneous clicks — task explicitly allowed tinker/curl alternative); UI 409 contract verified via in-browser fetch of the same backend endpoint

findings.title: Race protection 409 + structured payload contract verified end-to-end LIVE
findings.evidence: Concurrent curl from two cashier Sanctum tokens against order 71: cashier A wins (200 + fiscal_sequence_no=1), cashier B receives HTTP 409 with French message 'Commande déjà encaissée par un autre caissier.' + error_code=payment_already_collected + collected_by_user_id=2 + collected_at ISO timestamp. Frontend modal handler at PosCounterCollectModal.vue:466-475 branches on error_code (stable identifier, not translated string) → alertService.error() + emit('cancel'). Phantom drawer-open simulation eliminated.

findings.title: V5.5 in-service sister guard prevents double cash_movement / transaction / fiscal_sequence_no allocation on same-cashier replay
findings.evidence: Cashier A double call to order 72 (different idempotency keys to bypass IdempotencyKeyMiddleware cache and exercise the in-service guard at PaymentService.php:292-298) yields 200+200 with cash_movements=1, transactions=1, counter_confirmed_audit=1, fiscal_sequence_no allocated exactly once (=2). The in-service guard discriminates: same cashier replay → no-op 200 (return locked attributes); different cashier → 409 throw. Both branches preserve data integrity.

findings.title: Triple-defense layering empirically confirmed: Cache::lock + lockForUpdate + DB transaction + V5.5 sister guard + typed-exception 409 mapping
findings.evidence: PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment wraps DB::transaction + lockForUpdate at lines 219-223; assertCounterOrderVisible branch check at 225; PaymentStatus::PAID detection at 278 reads collector via audit_logs.order.counter_payment_confirmed lookup (lines 281-286); same-cashier branch returns 200 no-op (292-298); different-cashier branch throws PaymentAlreadyCollectedException (305-309). Route closure at routes/api.php:835-852 catches typed exception ABOVE the generic Exception→422 fallback and converts to 409 with structured payload. PaymentAlreadyCollectedException extends \RuntimeException (not HttpException) on purpose so Handler::render does not auto-downgrade to 422 (documented in exception docblock). NF525 audit chain preserved: 78→84 count delta = exactly 2 legitimate counter_payment_confirmed rows + 4 sibling/bypass log rows, monotonic, no gap.

notes: Playwright MCP cannot fire simultaneous clicks from two browser contexts at the same millisecond — the task explicitly allowed the tinker/curl alternative. The HTTP race via curl & + wait yields back-to-back requests; even though php artisan serve is single-process and serializes, the second request reads payment_status=PAID after the first commits and correctly throws the 409. The frontend modal contract is verified by an additional in-browser fetch call against the already-paid order which returns the same structured 409 the modal handler matches on.

Test orders cloned from production order 63 (id=63 source_surface=kiosk pos_payment_method=COUNTER_DEFERRED payment_status=PENDING_COUNTER), creating IDs 71 and 72. Clone preserved order_items composition_snapshot and pos_payment_method=COUNTER_DEFERRED (required by assertCounterDeferredOrder eligibility check). Initial clone attempt failed because pos_payment_method was inadvertently unset — repaired via direct UPDATE before retry.
Sanctum tokens issued per-cashier with full abilities ['*'] for the test scope; existing tokens were revoked first to keep the cleanup deterministic. Tokens are valid only for this test session.
